title: anemone tenuifolia
intro: Anemone tenuifolia, commonly known as Yon-wol-hwa in Korea, is a plant species belonging to the Ranunculaceae family. It is traditionally used in medicine to treat various health conditions, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Anemone tenuifolia include promoting wound healing, reducing fever, and alleviating pain, primarily due to its bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Anemone tenuifolia have been found to exhibit antiviral and anti-tumor activities, further solidifying its medicinal value.
